screens.name: Home — home, home-transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show the dominant gold orb, touch instruction and unavailable omen, with supplied runtime evidence reporting responsive layout, contrast and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Give the sample question above the orb slightly more visual presence so it reads as an invitation without competing with the hero.

screens.name: Home — populated omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a populated daily omen and a notably faint question above the orb.
findings: Keep the question legible throughout its displayed state, including frames with a populated omen.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 maintains the orb and invitation across both samples, while supplied runtime evidence describes automatic progression after 650ms and immediate progression with reduced motion.
findings: Retain the short automatic handoff and verify that repeated entry never leaves the invitation waiting indefinitely.

screens.name: Ask — normal, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a prominent question field, alternative-person action and submit button, with the large-text form extending beyond the initial viewport.
findings: Label the alternative mode as “Switch to asking about someone” so it cannot be mistaken for the current form heading.

screens.name: Named-person Ask — normal, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show Alex, first-name privacy guidance and a person-specific question beneath an “Ask about myself” action, with supplied runtime evidence reporting validation and a real teen reading.
findings: Make the current person mode explicit and distinguish its first-name label from the action that switches back to self.

screens.name: Follow-up card 1 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows a clear question, four separated answers and progress, while supplied runtime evidence reports single keyboard activation, focus transfer and answer preservation.
findings: Clarify whether the first question asks about plan certainty or progress, since “Barely started” and “Nearly certain” describe different things.

screens.name: Follow-up card 2 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows concise obstacle options with stable composition across samples, supported by the reported keyboard and Back-navigation checks.
findings: Preserve the concise options, broad rows and automatic focus handoff.

screens.name: Follow-up card 3 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows readable support choices and the final progress position in the explicitly synthetic three-card layout sequence.
findings: Retain this as a layout stress case without treating it as evidence of real adaptive question quality.

screens.name: Custom answer — settled, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show persistent question context, a multiline field and disabled continuation, while supplied runtime evidence reports constrained-height editing, answer retention and restored Choices focus.
findings: Increase the normal-size question context slightly so opening custom entry does not abruptly demote the question to small utility text.

screens.name: Planning — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a stable loading composition with a plain-language activity description, time expectation, credit reassurance and Cancel.
findings: Preserve the visible time expectation and no-credit-spent explanation alongside cancellation.

screens.name: Research — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 retains the loading composition while explaining forecast preparation, with supplied runtime evidence reporting reduced-motion and isolated rendering checks.
findings: Keep the stage-specific explanation visible throughout longer waits.

screens.name: Planning error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows an explicit failure, no-charge reassurance, prominent retry and question editing, supported by reported connection-failure and successful-retry evidence.
findings: Preserve the retry-first hierarchy and explicit credit reassurance.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the retry and edit recovery choices without visually presenting the failure as success.
findings: Keep answer review available without forcing users to restart the reading.

screens.name: Voice unavailable — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 makes typing primary and displays a microphone failure notice near the bottom, while supplied runtime evidence reports a working typing fallback.
findings: Place a short persistent voice-unavailable explanation beside the typing action so the reason does not depend on a distant dismissible notice.

screens.name: Age confirmation — normal, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show clear age alternatives at both sizes, and supplied runtime evidence reports persisted eligibility and an under-13 reload gate.
findings: Preserve the direct age question and equally readable alternative response.

screens.name: Birthday onboarding — normal, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show an explicitly formatted date field and Skip for now, with supplied runtime evidence reporting real invalid and valid onboarding.
findings: Show a concrete date example or segmented date entry to reduce the burden of manually interpreting YYYY-MM-DD.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — normal, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows four focus choices and completion controls but repeats birthday guidance beneath the focus question and shows no selected focus.
findings: Replace the birthday guidance with a short selection instruction that explains whether focus is optional and how many choices are allowed.

screens.name: Reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show a dominant forecast, speculative label, date and sharing action, supported by supplied real-reading, credit and explanation evidence.
findings: Clarify whether the displayed date is the forecast deadline or the check-back date using an explicit label.

screens.name: Why forecast — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 preserves forecast context and disclosure controls but displays the long stress explanation as a dense paragraph, with supplied runtime evidence reporting disclosure keyboard and focus checks.
findings: Separate recorded context, assumptions and source limitations into visually distinct paragraphs without removing the stress content.

screens.name: Expanded evidence — settled, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show long evidence sections at scrolled positions and enlarged text, while supplied runtime evidence reports preserved content, accessible disclosures and focus restoration.
findings: Strengthen section-level orientation so readers entering mid-scroll can identify the current evidence category without reading the entire preceding block.

screens.name: Check-in — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 places three outcome responses beneath the forecast while the strongest button remains Share this glimpse.
findings: Give the outcome question greater emphasis on the check-in screen so sharing does not outrank its main task.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Yes
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a checkmarked Yes choice, persistent saved status and a dismissible confirmation, supported by reported history persistence.
findings: Reduce the confirmation panel's visual weight while retaining the persistent saved outcome.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Not quite
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a checkmarked Not quite response together with inline saved status and a history confirmation.
findings: Use the inline saved state as the primary confirmation and keep the supplementary notice compact.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Not yet
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 differentiates pending status with a selected Not yet response and “Still waiting to unfold” confirmation.
findings: Keep the pending status distinct from a failed forecast when the user revisits history.

screens.name: History — empty, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows an explicit local-storage note, clear empty state and an Ask the Ball action with consistent navigation.
findings: Preserve the direct route from the empty state into a first reading.

screens.name: History — populated, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 distinguishes reading date, original question, forecast and future check-back date, with supplied runtime evidence reporting real history behavior.
findings: Format check-back dates in the same readable month-name style used on the forecast screen.

screens.name: History — outcome persisted
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 visibly replaces the first entry's pending date with a checkmarked Came true status while retaining other dated entries.
findings: Retain the text-and-symbol outcome indicator and standardize the remaining date presentation.

screens.name: History — populated stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows multiple large forecast rows continuing toward the fixed tab bar, and the supplied layout account identifies scrolling coverage.
findings: Capture the final row fully scrolled above the tab bar to make end-of-list clearance directly reviewable.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample stars, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 labels the offline samples, provides Retry and marks Love with both color and a check before presenting its question.
findings: Make the star topics read more clearly as selectable controls while retaining the open constellation layout.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 explicitly reports the outage and shows Retry, disabled creation and explanatory sharing text, supported by supplied offline-control checks.
findings: Place the offline reason directly beside the disabled creation action to connect its appearance with the cause.

screens.name: Plans — settled, transition and large text
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show selected yearly pricing, monthly pricing, packs and explicit simulation labels, with supplied runtime evidence reporting simulated purchase and restore behavior.
findings: State the actual annual charge beside the primary continuation action so the monthly equivalent cannot dominate purchase interpretation.

screens.name: Share — settled, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–19 show a story preview, image download, privacy explanation and collapsed optional actions, supported by supplied real PNG and export-recovery evidence.
findings: Provide an obvious way to inspect the small preview at readable size before downloading.

screens.name: Share — expanded Invite & remind, normal and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows invitation and reminder rows beneath the privacy statement, with enlarged content continuing below the viewport.
findings: Keep the expanded-section state and its return path easy to locate after scrolling through enlarged options.

screens.name: Story image — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–20 show the larger export artifact, speculative disclaimer and download action, while supplied runtime evidence reports a real 1080×1920 PNG.
findings: Increase the smallest disclaimer and brand-caption text so the exported image remains readable after social-platform scaling.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect during planning — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 presents a support action, explanation, alternative question routes and explicit no-credit/no-memory reassurance, supported by reported real sensitive redirection.
findings: Add a brief destination description to “Find support near you” so users know what kind of resource will open.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect during prediction — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 retain the same support-first hierarchy and no-charge reassurance after the later reading stage.
findings: Give the support destination the same explicit description in both redirect stages.

screens.name: You — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 21–22 separate birth profile, plan and empty memory sections, with supplied runtime evidence reporting profile and memory workflows.
findings: Use consistent human-readable capitalization and date formatting in the birth-profile summary.

screens.name: Birthday editing — settled, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows the existing birthday, editable date, Save and Forget actions, with supplied runtime evidence reporting doubled input text and profile editing.
findings: Add a persistent field label to the editable date instead of relying on the repeated profile summary for context.

screens.name: Optional birth details — settled, transition and 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows birth time, city and disabled lookup/reveal actions, while supplied runtime evidence reports live Copenhagen geocoding and calculated signs.
findings: Explain beside the disabled reveal action that a selected city is required before the calculation can continue.

screens.name: Settings controls — normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows labeled preferences and an enabled large-text state, supported by supplied full-row keyboard, persistence, focus and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Preserve clear section context when scrolling so the clipped memory heading does not become an ambiguous fragment beneath the fixed header.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets show consistent illustrated orbs at several scales, while supplied runtime evidence reports actionable Home behavior, animation sampling and stopped rendering under reduced motion.
findings: Retain the adjacent touch instruction wherever the orb serves as a control rather than decoration.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Home, Sky, History and You screens show labeled icons, underlined active destinations and a raised Ask orb, with supplied evidence reporting enlarged-label clearance.
findings: Preserve the underline and labels so active navigation never relies on gold color alone.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently pair a page identity or close control with balances that visibly vary between one, zero and test Plus states.
findings: Use “1 reading left today” where space permits to make the counter understandable without prior product knowledge.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream pill buttons establish consistent primary emphasis, and supplied runtime evidence reports keyboard operation, disabled states and guarded export activation.
findings: Preserve full labels and vertical expansion when text wraps at 200%.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: The sheets use gold text, centered white rows and separator-backed rows for several different secondary actions.
findings: Standardize the visual treatment of navigation, mode switching and secondary commands so their roles are easier to recognize.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 03–04 show spacious separated options, with supplied evidence reporting Space/Enter activation once, forward focus movement and preserved Back answers.
findings: Maintain broad interactive rows and the verified single-activation behavior.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show readable serif question entry inside a strong gold outline with an additional lower rule, supported by reported input scaling and validation.
findings: Simplify the competing outer outline and lower rule while preserving a clearly visible keyboard focus indicator.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged Ask and custom-answer screenshots show wrapping editable content, and supplied measurements report exact doubled text and retained editing under constrained height.
findings: Preserve scrolling access to submission while reducing decorative input borders to a single clear boundary.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 17 shows position-and-color switch states with labels, backed by reported full-row activation, keyboard operation, focus outline and persistence.
findings: Retain full-row interaction and state persistence for all three preferences.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show both a populated omen fixture and an explicit no-omen state beneath the Home instruction.
findings: Keep the unavailable state concise and explain whether returning tomorrow is the only route to another omen.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 19 connects a checkmarked Love star to a labeled sample question and Ask this too action.
findings: Strengthen the selectable affordance of each star-and-label group without adding enclosing cards.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 separates offline status, privacy explanation, disabled creation and a restricted sharing preference.
findings: Tie disabled controls to their immediate offline or eligibility explanation.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 uses a date rail, original question, forecast and either check-back or saved-outcome metadata.
findings: Standardize readable dates and verify the whole row has an obvious keyboard focus treatment when opened.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 12–13 distinguish the selected annual plan with a checkmark and gold rule while showing the annual total and monthly equivalent.
findings: Prioritize the amount actually charged and repeat its billing interval near continuation.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 17–19 show a visually coherent but small portrait preview whose disclaimer and branding are difficult to read at its displayed size.
findings: Expose a clearly labeled larger preview and retain accessible text outside the raster image.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice and outcome screenshots show dismissible notices, and supplied runtime evidence reports retry, export-failure and connection recovery.
findings: Keep transient notices compact and place persistent explanations next to the actions they affect.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently combine expressive serif headings with sans-serif utility text, while long explanations and very small metadata reveal the system's weaker cases.
findings: Improve long-text chunking and the smallest supporting type before enlarging or ornamenting any headings.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and warm lower gradients remain coherent across sheets, with supplied evidence reporting sampled transition contrast, reduced-motion cessation and isolated performance checks.
findings: Preserve the restrained contrast behind text and rerun sampled checks when mist intensity changes.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Onboarding shows a format label while profile editing shows a bare populated date, with supplied evidence reporting invalid/valid entry and exact text scaling.
findings: Use a persistent Birthday label and a concrete date example consistently in both contexts.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show two unambiguous age responses, supported by supplied persistence, decline and reload-gate evidence.
findings: Preserve the explicit alternatives and avoid making birthday disclosure necessary for eligibility confirmation.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheet 11 shows four focus rows without a pictured selected state or an instruction explaining the selection model.
findings: Add a concise selection instruction and capture a selected row with an explicit non-color indicator.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 20–22 show Sun sign, age band, birthday and editing routes grouped under Your sky.
findings: Present “Gemini” and the birthday in consistent reader-facing capitalization and date format.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheet 20 shows optional time and city fields with disabled actions, supported by supplied live geocoding and calculation evidence.
findings: Explain the required city-selection step beside the disabled calculation action.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a first-name field and privacy guidance beneath a switch-to-self action, with supplied evidence reporting name validation.
findings: Give the field an explicit First name label and make the current person mode visibly distinct from its switch action.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show expandable reasoning, assumptions and sources, with supplied evidence reporting Enter activation, heading focus and return focus.
findings: Strengthen section headings and paragraph boundaries while preserving the full long-content fixture.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Supplied runtime evidence reports Preparing image, single-encoding protection, independent Invite availability and retry after injected failure, but the sheets do not show those transient states.
findings: Include preparing and failed-export captures at normal and 200% text so status placement and readability can be judged directly.

components.name: Reading progress indicator
components.evidence: Sheets 03–04 combine short gold progress marks with explicit numbered positions in the synthetic three-card sequence.
findings: Preserve the textual position alongside the decorative progress marks.

components.name: Outcome selection and saved status
components.evidence: Sheet 12 shows each selected outcome with a checkmark and persistent saved text, backed by supplied history persistence evidence.
findings: Keep the persistent text-and-symbol confirmation when dismissing the supplementary notice.

components.name: Forecast presentation
components.evidence: Reveal and check-in screens consistently pair a prominent forecast with speculative qualification, a date and an explanation route.
findings: Name the date's role explicitly so a check-back date cannot be confused with the forecast's stated horizon.

limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments from the attached sheets and supplied runtime account; no files, source, previous ratings or live application were inspected.
For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding only null dimensions.
The authorized threshold is not met: numerous screens and components remain below A=9 or F=9, although several bounded browser states support scores of 9.
No hard-gate failure is established by this material; content below a captured viewport is not treated as unreachable because scrolling and layout checks are explicitly reported.
Paired transition screenshots support compositional consistency at sampled moments; continuous transitions and performance are supported only by the supplied runtime account.
The sheets do not directly show every focus, pressed, validation, export-loading or export-error state, so their visual quality remains partly unverified.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, hardware keyboard/VoiceOver, microphone, haptics, real payments, configured Supabase/Auth and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Offline Sky and Circles are evaluated as disclosed fallback states; their presentation does not establish working connected social functionality.
Synthetic forecasts, long evidence text and the three-card sequence establish layout stress coverage only; their wording is not classified as a production-copy defect or proof of predictive quality.
The separate image-load error for '-' does not prevent evaluation of the 22 displayed sheets.
topFixes: Clarify current self/person mode and make the alternative mode an explicit switch action.
Replace birthday guidance on focus onboarding with selection instructions and demonstrate its selected state.
Break long explanations into clear context, assumption and source sections while preserving all stress content.
Label forecast dates explicitly and standardize readable dates across history and profile.
Improve small share-preview and exported disclaimer legibility, and capture export loading/error states.
Add persistent birthday labels and local explanations for disabled birth-detail and offline creation actions.
Give check-in outcomes greater emphasis than sharing and keep confirmation notices compact.
